CogneeValidationError: SearchPreconditionError: Search prerequisites not met: no database/default user found. Initialize Cognee before searching by:
• running `await cognee.add(...)` followed by `await cognee.cognify()`. (Status code: 422)
IngestionError: IngestionError: Data type not supported: <class 'int'> (Status code: 415)
PermissionDeniedError: PermissionDeniedError: Request owner does not have necessary permission: [delete] for all datasets requested. (Status code: 403)

LLMAPIKeyNotSetError: LLMAPIKeyNotSetError: LLM API key is not set. (Status code: 422) Fix: Set LLM_API_KEY in your .env (copy .env.template to start). Cognee defaults to the OpenAI provider; set LLM_PROVIDER and LLM_MODEL as well to use another provider, and configure EM
